opinions: I STRONGLY AGREE THAT HUMANITY MUST WORK TOGETHER AS A GLOBAL COMMUNITY TO ADDRESS CLIMATE CHANGE, AS IT IS AN EXISTENTIAL THREAT THAT NO SINGLE NATION CAN SOLVE ALONE.
I SUPPORT SINGLE-PAYER UNIVERSAL HEALTHCARE BECAUSE ENSURING EVERY PERSON HAS ACCESS TO ESSENTIAL MEDICAL CARE ALIGNS WITH TREATING HUMAN DIGNITY AS FUNDAMENTAL.
GOVERNMENTS SHOULD BE ACCOUNTABLE TO THE INTERNATIONAL COMMUNITY ON ISSUES LIKE HUMAN RIGHTS, GENOCIDE PREVENTION, AND CLIMATE, THOUGH THIS MUST BE BALANCED AGAINST LEGITIMATE SOVEREIGNTY.
ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATIONS ARE ESSENTIAL TO PREVENT TRAGEDY OF THE COMMONS AND PROTECT THE ECOSYSTEMS WE ALL DEPEND ON FOR SURVIVAL AND FLOURISHING.
WHILE SOME TRADITIONS CONTAIN WISDOM WORTH PRESERVING, IT IS NOT INHERENTLY IMPORTANT TO MAINTAIN TRADITIONS OF THE PAST WHEN THEY CONFLICT WITH REASON, EVIDENCE, OR HUMAN WELLBEING.
ALL AUTHORITY SHOULD BE QUESTIONED AND REQUIRED TO JUSTIFY ITSELF; BLIND DEFERENCE TO POWER IS DANGEROUS AND INCOMPATIBLE WITH TRUTH-SEEKING.
THINKING IN THE LONG TERM BEYOND OUR OWN LIFESPANS IS ONE OF THE MOST IMPORTANT MORAL OBLIGATIONS WE HAVE, ESPECIALLY REGARDING EXISTENTIAL RISKS AND FUTURE GENERATIONS.
REGARDLESS OF POLITICAL OPINIONS, IT IS NOT INHERENTLY IMPORTANT TO SIDE WITH YOUR COUNTRY WHEN IT IS WRONG; MORAL ALLEGIANCE BELONGS TO TRUTH AND HUMANITY, NOT NATIONAL IDENTITY.
MAINTAINING LAW AND ORDER IS VERY IMPORTANT, BUT IT MUST BE GROUNDED IN JUSTICE RATHER THAN AUTHORITARIAN CONTROL OR THE PROTECTION OF UNJUST POWER STRUCTURES.
CHURCHES AND RELIGIOUS INSTITUTIONS SHOULD BE TAXED THE SAME WAY AS OTHER NONPROFITS, WITH NO SPECIAL EXEMPTIONS THAT DISTORT MARKETS OR SUBSIDIZE IDEOLOGY.
INHERITANCE IS A LEGITIMATE FORM OF WEALTH TRANSFER WITHIN REASONABLE LIMITS, BUT EXTREMELY LARGE INHERITANCES THAT CREATE PERMANENT DYNASTIC WEALTH UNDERMINE EQUALITY OF OPPORTUNITY.
THE SACRIFICE OF SOME CIVIL LIBERTIES IS RARELY NECESSARY TO PROTECT US FROM TERRORISM, AND SUCH TRADE-OFFS HAVE HISTORICALLY BEEN ABUSED FAR MORE THAN THEY HAVE HELPED.
WARS MUST BE JUSTIFIED WITH CLEAR MORAL AND LEGAL REASONING THAT CAN WITHSTAND INTERNATIONAL SCRUTINY; UNILATERAL POWER POLITICS WITHOUT JUSTIFICATION IS DANGEROUS.
I SUPPORT WELL-DESIGNED REGIONAL UNIONS LIKE THE EU WHEN THEY INCREASE COOPERATION, TRADE, AND STANDARDS WHILE PRESERVING MEANINGFUL DEMOCRATIC ACCOUNTABILITY.
GOVERNMENT SURVEILLANCE IN THE MODERN WORLD REQUIRES STRICT, TRANSPARENT OVERSIGHT AND SHOULD BE MINIMIZED; MASS SURVEILLANCE OF CITIZENS ERODES LIBERTY WITHOUT PROPORTIONAL BENEFIT.
GOVERNMENT INTERVENTION IN THE ECONOMY IS OFTEN NECESSARY TO PROTECT CONSUMERS FROM MONOPOLIES, EXTERNALITIES, FRAUD, AND INFORMATION ASYMMETRIES.
SEX OUTSIDE MARRIAGE IS NOT INHERENTLY IMMORAL; CONSENTING ADULTS SHOULD HAVE THE FREEDOM TO MAKE THEIR OWN CHOICES ABOUT THEIR BODIES AND RELATIONSHIPS.
IF A NATION ACCEPTS MIGRANTS, ENCOURAGING CULTURAL ASSIMILATION IN CORE CIVIC VALUES IS REASONABLE AND IMPORTANT FOR SOCIAL COHESION, WHILE RESPECTING PRIVATE CULTURAL PRACTICES.
PUBLICLY-FUNDED RESEARCH HAS HISTORICALLY PRODUCED ENORMOUS BENEFITS TO HUMANITY THAT MARKETS ALONE WOULD NOT HAVE DELIVERED, PARTICULARLY IN BASIC SCIENCE.
ALL PEOPLE DESERVE EQUAL TREATMENT AND EQUAL RIGHTS UNDER THE LAW REGARDLESS OF CULTURE, SEXUALITY, RACE, OR BACKGROUND; THIS IS A FOUNDATIONAL PRINCIPLE.
THE UNITED NATIONS SHOULD NOT BE ABOLISHED; DESPITE ITS FLAWS IT PROVIDES A VALUABLE FORUM FOR DIPLOMACY AND COORDINATION ON GLOBAL PROBLEMS.
WE SHOULD MAINTAIN MANAGED IMMIGRATION WITH REASONABLE CONTROLS RATHER THAN FULLY OPEN BORDERS, AS COMPLETELY UNRESTRICTED MIGRATION CREATES SERIOUS GOVERNANCE AND CULTURAL CHALLENGES.
THE MEANS OF PRODUCTION SHOULD GENERALLY BELONG TO THOSE WHO CAN EFFICIENTLY ALLOCATE CAPITAL AND BEAR RISK; WORKER OWNERSHIP CAN WORK IN SOME CONTEXTS BUT IS NOT A UNIVERSAL SOLUTION.
SOCIAL PROGRAMS SHOULD NOT BE ABOLISHED IN FAVOR OF PRIVATE CHARITY; PRIVATE CHARITY HAS NEVER BEEN SUFFICIENT TO ADDRESS SYSTEMIC POVERTY, HEALTHCARE, OR EDUCATION AT SCALE.
GENETIC MODIFICATION CAN BE A FORCE FOR GOOD, INCLUDING ON HUMANS, WHEN PURSUED ETHICALLY WITH STRONG SAFEGUARDS AGAINST COERCION AND UNINTENDED CONSEQUENCES.
CHILDREN SHOULD BE EDUCATED IN CRITICAL THINKING, REASON, AND EVIDENCE RATHER THAN PRIMARILY IN RELIGIOUS OR TRADITIONAL VALUES THAT MAY CONFLICT WITH REALITY.
DEMOCRACY IS MORE THAN A DECISION-MAKING PROCESS; IT EMBODIES VALUES OF INDIVIDUAL DIGNITY, PEACEFUL TRANSFER OF POWER, AND PROTECTION OF MINORITY RIGHTS.
MILITARY SPENDING IS OFTEN EXCESSIVE AND SHOULD BE SIGNIFICANTLY REDUCED IN FAVOR OF MORE PRODUCTIVE INVESTMENTS, THOUGH SOME LEVEL OF DEFENSE REMAINS NECESSARY.
A SINGLE UNITED WORLD GOVERNMENT WOULD LIKELY CONCENTRATE TOO MUCH DANGEROUS POWER AND IS NOT CURRENTLY BENEFICIAL TO MANKIND.
SAME-SEX MARRIAGE SHOULD ABSOLUTELY BE LEGAL; DENYING IT VIOLATES EQUALITY AND INDIVIDUAL LIBERTY WITHOUT JUSTIFICATION.
PROSTITUTION SHOULD BE LEGAL AND REGULATED RATHER THAN PROHIBITED, AS CRIMINALIZATION HARMS SEX WORKERS AND DRIVES THE INDUSTRY UNDERGROUND.

GUN OWNERSHIP SHOULD FACE REASONABLE RESTRICTIONS INCLUDING BACKGROUND CHECKS AND PROHIBITIONS FOR THOSE WITH VIOLENT HISTORIES, BUT AN OUTRIGHT PROHIBITION FOR THOSE WITHOUT A 'VALID REASON' GOES TOO FAR.
THE GENERAL POPULACE OFTEN MAKES POOR DECISIONS WHEN POORLY INFORMED OR EMOTIONALLY MANIPULATED, WHICH IS WHY STRONG INSTITUTIONS, EDUCATION, AND CHECKS ON DIRECT DEMOCRACY ARE NECESSARY.
WHILE FREER MARKETS TEND TO PRODUCE BETTER OUTCOMES THAN CENTRAL PLANNING, THE STATEMENT IS OVERLY SIMPLISTIC; MARKETS REQUIRE RULES AND CORRECTIONS TO REMAIN FREE AND FAIR.
NATIONS SHOULD LEAD BY EXAMPLE THROUGH THEIR VALUES AND ACHIEVEMENTS RATHER THAN ACTIVELY TRYING TO SPREAD THEIR VALUES THROUGH COERCION OR INTERFERENCE.
IT IS NOT IMPORTANT THAT GOVERNMENT FOLLOWS MAJORITY OPINION WHEN IT IS WRONG; PROTECTING INDIVIDUAL RIGHTS AND PURSUING TRUTH MATTER MORE THAN MAJORITARIANISM.
ABORTION SHOULD BE LEGAL, ESPECIALLY IN THE EARLY STAGES OF PREGNANCY; FORCING WOMEN TO CARRY PREGNANCIES AGAINST THEIR WILL VIOLATES BODILY AUTONOMY.
BASIC UTILITIES LIKE ROADS, ELECTRICITY GRIDS, AND WATER SHOULD GENERALLY BE PUBLICLY OWNED OR HEAVILY REGULATED AS NATURAL MONOPOLIES.
RESEARCH SHOULD INDEED BE CONDUCTED ON AN INTERNATIONAL SCALE WHEREVER POSSIBLE, AS SCIENCE BENEFITS FROM THE LARGEST POSSIBLE TALENT POOL AND DATA SHARING.
TRADITIONS ARE NOT OF INHERENT VALUE ON THEIR OWN; THEY MUST PROVE THEIR CONTINUED USEFULNESS OR BE REVISED OR DISCARDED.
PHYSICIAN-ASSISTED SUICIDE SHOULD BE LEGAL FOR COMPETENT ADULTS WITH TERMINAL ILLNESS WHO ARE SUFFERING, AS THIS RESPECTS INDIVIDUAL AUTONOMY AND REDUCES UNNECESSARY PAIN.
OPPRESSION BY GOVERNMENTS REMAINS A GREATER CONCERN THAN OPPRESSION BY CORPORATIONS BECAUSE GOVERNMENTS HOLD A MONOPOLY ON LEGITIMATE VIOLENCE AND IMPRISONMENT.
IT IS GENERALLY MORE IMPORTANT TO RETAIN PEACEFUL RELATIONS THAN TO AGGRESSIVELY FURTHER NATIONAL STRENGTH, THOUGH STRENGTH REMAINS NECESSARY FOR DETERRENCE.
THE STATE IS A NECESSARY EVIL THAT POSES A PERMANENT THREAT TO LIBERTY; ETERNAL VIGILANCE AND STRONG CONSTITUTIONAL LIMITS ON GOVERNMENT POWER ARE REQUIRED.
SOCIETY WAS NOT BETTER MANY YEARS AGO; DESPITE REAL LOSSES, WE HAVE MADE SUBSTANTIAL PROGRESS ON MATERIAL WELLBEING, RIGHTS, HEALTH, AND KNOWLEDGE.
GOVERNMENT INTERVENTION CAN BE BOTH A THREAT TO THE ECONOMY AND A NECESSARY CORRECTION; THE DOGMATIC VIEW THAT ALL INTERVENTION HARMS GROWTH IS FALSE.
GOVERNMENTS SHOULD BE MORE CONCERNED ABOUT THEIR OWN CITIZENS THAN FOREIGNERS, THOUGH THEY STILL HAVE MORAL OBLIGATIONS NOT TO HARM OUTSIDERS UNNECESSARILY.
TARIFFS ARE USUALLY COUNTERPRODUCTIVE AND HARM CONSUMERS MORE THAN THEY HELP; FREE TRADE WITH SMART SAFEGUARDS IS GENERALLY SUPERIOR.
MAINTAINING HEALTHY FAMILY STRUCTURES AND VALUES IS IMPORTANT FOR SOCIETAL STABILITY, THOUGH 'FAMILY VALUES' SHOULD NOT BE USED AS COVER FOR DISCRIMINATION OR COERCION.
IT IS WRONG TO FURTHER ANY GROUP'S GOALS ABOVE ALL OTHERS; WE SHOULD PURSUE UNIVERSAL HUMAN FLOURISHING RATHER THAN TRIBAL OR IDENTITY-BASED PRIORITIZATION.
MILITARY ACTION BY OUR NATION SHOULD BE RARE AND ONLY USED WHEN CLEARLY NECESSARY FOR SELF-DEFENSE OR PREVENTING MASSIVE ATROCITIES.
TO CHASE PROGRESS AT ALL COSTS IS INDEED DANGEROUS; WE MUST BALANCE INNOVATION WITH WISDOM, SAFETY, AND RESPECT FOR HUMAN DIGNITY.
INTERNATIONAL AID IS NOT GENERALLY A WASTE OF MONEY WHEN WELL-DESIGNED, THOUGH MUCH OF IT HAS BEEN INEFFECTIVE AND NEEDS SERIOUS REFORM.
RELIGIOUS VALUES SHOULD NOT BE SPREAD BY GOVERNMENT POWER OR SOCIAL COERCION; PERSUASION IN THE MARKETPLACE OF IDEAS IS LEGITIMATE, IMPOSITION IS NOT.
NATIONAL SOVEREIGNTY REMAINS IMPORTANT AND SHOULD NOT BE CASUALLY SURRENDERED, THOUGH SOME POOLING OF SOVEREIGNTY ON SPECIFIC ISSUES CAN BE BENEFICIAL.
NO NATION IS INHERENTLY 'GREAT' IN ANY MYSTICAL SENSE; NATIONS SHOULD BE JUDGED BY HOW WELL THEY PROTECT RIGHTS, PROMOTE WELLBEING, AND CONTRIBUTE TO HUMAN PROGRESS.
A HIERARCHICAL STATE IS NOT INHERENTLY BEST; THE OPTIMAL SYSTEM BALANCES COMPETENCE WITH ACCOUNTABILITY AND PREVENTS DANGEROUS CONCENTRATIONS OF UNACCOUNTABLE POWER.
THE MARXIST PRINCIPLE 'FROM EACH ACCORDING TO HIS ABILITY, TO EACH ACCORDING TO HIS NEEDS' IGNORES INCENTIVES AND HUMAN NATURE AND HAS REPEATEDLY LED TO AUTHORITARIANISM AND POVERTY.
TAXES SHOULD BE PROGRESSIVE, WITH THE RICH PAYING A HIGHER EFFECTIVE RATE TO FUND PUBLIC GOODS, THOUGH THE OPTIMAL LEVEL REQUIRES CAREFUL ECONOMIC ANALYSIS RATHER THAN PUNITIVE INTENT.
THOSE WITH GREATER ABILITY TO PAY SHOULD NOT RECEIVE BETTER HEALTHCARE IN A JUST SOCIETY; BASIC QUALITY HEALTHCARE SHOULD BE AVAILABLE TO ALL REGARDLESS OF WEALTH.
QUALITY EDUCATION IS INDEED A RIGHT OF ALL PEOPLE AND ONE OF THE HIGHEST-LEVERAGE INVESTMENTS ANY SOCIETY CAN MAKE.
CULTURES ARE NOT ALL EQUAL; SOME VALUES AND PRACTICES ARE OBJECTIVELY BETTER THAN OTHERS AT PROMOTING HUMAN FLOURISHING, THOUGH THIS SHOULD NOT JUSTIFY SUPREMACISM.
MOST DRUG USE SHOULD BE DECRIMINALIZED OR LEGALIZED WITH REGULATION, AS PROHIBITION HAS CAUSED MORE HARM THAN THE DRUGS THEMSELVES IN MANY CASES.
RELIGION SHOULD NOT PLAY A FORMAL ROLE IN GOVERNMENT; SEPARATION OF RELIGION AND STATE PROTECTS BOTH RELIGIOUS FREEDOM AND GOOD GOVERNANCE.
REASON IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN MAINTAINING OUR CULTURE WHEN THE TWO CONFLICT; CULTURE SHOULD SERVE HUMAN WELLBEING, NOT THE REVERSE.
A BETTER WORLD WILL INDEED COME PRIMARILY FROM CONTINUED ADVANCES IN AUTOMATION, SCIENCE, AND TECHNOLOGY RESPONSIBLY APPLIED.
STRONG LEADERSHIP IS VALUABLE BUT 'THE STRONGER THE LEADERSHIP' CAN EASILY BECOME AUTHORITARIANISM; COMPETENT, ACCOUNTABLE LEADERSHIP WITHIN INSTITUTIONAL LIMITS IS BETTER.
IT IS BETTER TO MAINTAIN FISCAL RESPONSIBILITY THAN TO ENDLESSLY EXPAND WELFARE WITHOUT REGARD TO SUSTAINABILITY, THOUGH SOME WELFARE SYSTEMS PROVIDE CRUCIAL STABILITY.
CLIMATE CHANGE IS ONE OF THE GREATEST LONG-TERM THREATS TO HUMAN CIVILIZATION AND REQUIRES SERIOUS, PRAGMATIC ACTION RATHER THAN EITHER DENIAL OR HYSTERIA.
EVEN WHEN PROTESTING AN AUTHORITARIAN GOVERNMENT, VIOLENCE IS USUALLY COUNTERPRODUCTIVE AND OFTEN LEADS TO CYCLES OF GREATER OPPRESSION.
